title: Kenyan Cabbage Gratin
description: A crispy topped, creamy cabbage gratin, inspired by Kenyan flavors.
instructions: Chop the cabbage into thin slices and sauté in a pan until tender.
In a separate saucepan, heat the gratin sauce over low heat.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of cabbage slices.
Pour some of the heated gratin sauce over the cabbage.
Sprinkle some shredded cheese over the sauce.
Repeat steps 4-6 until all ingredients are used up, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Sprinkle the crispy topping over the cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
